subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and should it use a Feishu-specific key or a shared channel media policy?
rationale: The reported key is not a shipped documented Feishu setting, and adding one expands compatibility-sensitive config/default behavior for inbound media.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Media Policy
options.body: Route Feishu through a broader channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want one canonical setting across channels.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Keep current media behavior and document that Feishu supports only `mediaMaxMb` today, not a content-ignore switch.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu media hardening and docs work make this the best available owner for the channel policy shape.
